title: Curate versioned embedding + reranker performance profiles and release
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: onboard a vetted embedding model and a paired reranker into the catalog with pinned versions and publish performance profiles so product, SRE, and account teams can make deterministic routing and billing decisions. Scope: dataset prep, throughput/latency/quality measurements across prod-like sequences, generate a machine-readable profile (json) + human-facing summary, create rollout config for default pin, and publish profile artifacts to /model-catalog. Out of scope: training or fine-tuning, model architecture changes, or billing changes beyond metadata fields.
acceptance_criteria: Embedding and reranker are added to the model catalog with explicit version tags (e.g., embed-7b-v1, rr-3b-v2).

Profile JSON files exist in model-catalog with fields: seq_distribution, p50/p95 latency, tokens_per_sec, batch_recommendation, quantization_compatibility, and evaluation-precision metrics (mrr, ndcg).
Automated benchmark pipeline reproduces numbers and stores raw traces in the benchmarks bucket.
Rollout config created to pin existing customer routes to the new model versions with canary at 5% by default.
Release notes and short summary published to the internal docs and linked in the ticket.
technical_steps: Provision a dedicated 2xA100 staging pool that mirrors Dedicated runtime kernel selections.
Run embedding microbenchmarks across seq lengths [32,128,512] with batch sizes chosen by our batching estimator tool.
Execute reranker eval harness using the curated 5k query set and compute MRR@10 and NDCG@10.
Capture KV cache behavior under simulated chat workloads and record memory footprint at peak sequence lengths.
Run quantized inference (8-bit and 4-bit) and verify output parity thresholds are met; annotate quantization_sentinel in profile.
Generate profile JSON and markdown summary, upload to s3://redwood-model-catalog/embed-7b-v1/ and rr-3b-v2/ paths.
Open canary rollout PR against runtime config with 5% traffic allocation and automatic fallback to previous model on error budget breach.

2026-03-13 - Liam Chen: PR opened for runtime rollout config and profile files. Requesting review from infra and product. CI benchmarks green; integration tests show canary fallback working on injected error.
